codebook.definition: Respondents express uncertainty or lack of knowledge about how an interest rate increase affects inflation and unemployment. They often admit to guessing or not understanding the question.
example_quotes: I don't know anything about these kinds of things. So basically I have no idea.
It's a gamble.
I have no idea, thought it was a difficult question.

codebook.model_name: Interest Rate Increase Leads to Higher Costs
codebook.definition: Respondents believe that an increase in interest rates makes borrowing more expensive for companies, leading to higher costs, which are then passed on to consumers, resulting in higher inflation.
example_quotes: When interest rates rise, it becomes more expensive for companies.
Higher interest rates make borrowing money more expensive, also for companies. They compensate for these extra costs by increasing the price of their products (> inflation).
An increase in interest rates results in a decrease in activity. This decline in a country's activity can have a negative effect on unemployment.

codebook.model_name: Interest Rate Increase Reduces Spending and Investment
codebook.definition: Respondents suggest that higher interest rates lead to reduced borrowing and spending by both consumers and companies, which decreases demand and investment, potentially lowering inflation.
example_quotes: If interest rates rise, borrowing money is more expensive and people will spend less money.
Interest rates are increased to combat inflation. Higher interest rates, less demand, borrowing becomes more expensive, saving more attractive.
If interest rates rise, people will borrow less money and spend less.

codebook.definition: Respondents believe that higher interest rates lead to less investment by companies, which results in fewer job opportunities and higher unemployment.
example_quotes: Companies will invest less quickly; Borrowing will become more expensive, so house prices will drop somewhat.
Higher interest rates lead to a reduction in spending and therefore to a decrease in prices. This leads to a decrease in economic activity and thus to an increase in unemployment.
Companies have to pay more to make investments. They will make no or fewer investments, which will have a negative impact on unemployment.

codebook.model_name: Interest Rate Increase and Inflation Reduction
codebook.definition: Respondents believe that higher interest rates reduce inflation by making borrowing more expensive, which decreases spending and demand, leading to lower price increases.
example_quotes: Raising interest rates slows down the economy and inflation.
Interest rates are increased to combat inflation. Higher interest rates, less demand, borrowing becomes more expensive, saving more attractive.
Interest rate increases are a means of combating inflation.

codebook.definition: Respondents mention external factors such as global economic conditions, political instability, or other non-monetary factors as influencing inflation and unemployment, rather than the interest rate change itself.
example_quotes: Because the world economy will 'suffer' from the unstable political situation.
Trumpian turmoil in global markets and postponed investments.
Given the unrest in the world, this will have an influence.

codebook.definition: Respondents believe that higher interest rates encourage saving, which reduces money in circulation and can lead to lower inflation.
example_quotes: By increasing interest rates, there is more room to spend and inflation will therefore decrease slightly because people have more to spend.
Interest rates are increased to combat inflation. Higher interest rates, less demand, borrowing becomes more expensive, saving more attractive.
More people are going to save more, so there is less money around, which means less work, which means less work.

codebook.model_name: Interest Rate Increase and Consumer Behavior
codebook.definition: Respondents suggest that higher interest rates change consumer behavior, leading to less spending and borrowing, which affects inflation and potentially unemployment.
example_quotes: If interest rates rise, people will borrow less money and spend less.
Interest rates are increased to combat inflation. Higher interest rates, less demand, borrowing becomes more expensive, saving more attractive.
If interest rates rise, borrowing money is more expensive and people will spend less money.

codebook.model_name: Interest Rate Increase and Economic Growth
codebook.definition: Respondents believe that higher interest rates slow down economic growth by making borrowing more expensive, which reduces investment and spending.
example_quotes: Raising interest rates slows down the economy and inflation.
Interest rates are increased to combat inflation. Higher interest rates, less demand, borrowing becomes more expensive, saving more attractive.
If interest rates rise, borrowing money is more expensive and people will spend less money.

codebook.model_name: Interest Rate Increase and Labor Market
codebook.definition: Respondents mention that higher interest rates may not significantly impact the labor market due to existing conditions such as labor shortages or other structural factors.
example_quotes: There is currently a labor shortage. Inflation is even higher in surrounding countries than in our country.
Theoretically, unemployment should rise. However, due to the aging population, more vacancies will become available per percentage of employed people than was the case in recent years.
There is a labor shortage in key parts of the economy. due to, among other things, an aging population.
